$comment: Copy to pipeline.policy.json (gitignored) and adjust per environment. Loaded by src/config and merged over DEFAULT_POLICY via resolvePolicy().
$comment_edit_write: Edit/Write moved out of requireApproval and into allowedTools: they're this pipeline's core capability (it exists to make prompt-driven code changes), not a platform-config-style side effect. requireApproval stays reserved for mutations to the live downstream platform (mcp__platform__update_config) and, previously, would have blocked every single run before it could do anything.
$comment_git_push: mcp__git__git_push is intentionally in allowedTools, not requireApproval, even though it's an irreversible/outward-facing operation and the guardrail convention (see .claude/skills/add-guardrail-rule/SKILL.md) is to gate exactly that kind of tool behind approval. This is a deliberate exception for the trigger server's clone->edit->commit->push flow (src/server), decided explicitly rather than defaulted into — see CLAUDE.md.
